desc: Whether you’re training, target shooting, or just enjoying a day at the range, the Retay RXP 22 delivers superior performance. With its compact polymer frame and textured grip, this .22LR pistol offers ergonomic comfort and control for shooters of all levels. It’s loaded with innovative features like a reversible magazine release, threaded or standard barrel options, and precision-drilled chrome-finished steel barrels for exceptional accuracy.
